title: release cutover checklist - 2026-03-04 (scratchpad)
content:
Release cutover scratchpad - 2026-03-04
Owner: Samira Patel (on-call lead for cutover)
Collaborators: Jordan Lee (infra), Priya Nair (deploy/monitoring)
Slack: #release-cutover, paging: @oncall-sre

GOAL
- Ship v1.14.2 runtime hotfix + config migration to prod clusters (US + EU). Target window: 2026-03-05 02:00-03:30 UTC (low traffic).

PRE-CUTOVER (check before T-1h)
[ ] Confirm final PR merge: runtime PR #6789 merged to release branch (done)
[ ] Backports applied: list below
[ ] Tag created: v1.14.2 (signed)
[ ] Run smoke on staging: smoke-suite-basic (green)
[ ] Notify SE and CS leads: email + Slack (template at bottom)

BACKPORTS / PATCHES
- backport list (to release/1.14):
  - commit 9f3a2b1 - fix KV cache eviction bug (merged PR #6789)
  - commit a4d5e6c - increase default batch window for short seqs
  - commit b0c1d2e - metrics label fix (prometheus)
- commands I ran locally (notes):
  - git checkout release/1.14 && git cherry-pick 9f3a2b1 a4d5e6c b0c1d2e
  - run unit tests: make test-quick (passed)
  - docker build -t redwood/runtime:v1.14.2-release  (local build ok)

DEPLOY STEPS (planned)
1) Push release image to registry
   - docker push registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v1.14.2-release
2) Update deploy manifest (k8s) for dedicated and hosted clusters
   - kubectl -n infra set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v1.14.2-release
3) Canary in us-east-1 (10% traffic) for 15 minutes
   - monitor latencies + error rate in dashboard "runtime-canary-us-east"
4) If canary OK -> ramp to 50% for 10 minutes -> ramp to 100%
5) Repeat for eu-west-1 with same policy (staggered + 10m buffer)

ROLLBACK PLAN
- If error rate > 2% or latency p50 increases > 2x baseline during canary -> rollback to v1.14.1 immediately
- Rollback commands:
  - kubectl -n infra set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v1.14.1
  - trigger emergency alert in Slack with /pager and tag exec-oncall
- Post-rollback: collect debug logs, avoid re-deploy until root cause confirmed

VERIFICATION CHECKS (post deploy)
- smoke endpoints:
  - /health  (200)
  - /inference/streaming (basic prompt test)
  - embedding endpoint sanity-check (100 random inputs)
- metrics to watch:
  - runtime.latency.p50 / p95 (per-region)
  - error.rate (4xx/5xx) by model and route
  - kv_cache_hit_ratio (should not drop precipitously)
  - token throughput per pod
- dashboards: runtime-prod-overview, runtime-canary-us-east, infra-ops-alarms

COMMUNICATIONS
- Slack initial message (T-30m): short announcement to #release-cutover and #prod-alerts
- Email to CS/SE: subject "Planned runtime hotfix v1.14.2 - 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC" with brief impact note
- Post-deploy status update (canary OK / rolled out / rolled back) to same channels
- Template (use copy from Confluence): "Deployed v1.14.2 to PROD. Canary: OK. Rolling to remaining clusters now."

ESCALATION CONTACTS
- infra lead (pager): Jordan Lee - +1-555-0102 (Slack @jordan)
- on-call SRE: team pager (use /pager in #release-cutover)
- product/PM: Lila Gomez - lila@redwood.ai

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODO (during cutover)
- Verify whether KV cache warmup will cause slightly higher p50 for first 5 minutes - monitor closely
- Confirm no breaking schema change for observability metrics (metrics label fix included)
- Double-check dedicated cluster autoscaler config after image roll (Priya)

POST-CUTOVER (T+30m, T+2h)
[ ] T+30m: confirm p95 within baseline and no increase in 5xx
[ ] T+2h: run extended smoke with real traffic samples and verify quality metrics (sampling harness)
[ ] Create postmortem if rollback or if any alerts above threshold
[ ] Tag release notes + update CHANGELOG (Samira)

SNIPPETS / QUICK COMMANDS
- Check rollout status: kubectl -n infra rollout status deployment/runtime -w
- Force rollback to previous: kubectl -n infra set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood.ai/runtime:v1.14.1 && kubectl -n infra rollout status deployment/runtime -w
- Tail logs: kubectl -n infra logs deploy/runtime -c runtime --since=15m --tail=200

NOTES TO SELF
- If canary fails, keep detailed timeline in this doc (timestamps + actions) for postmortem
- Keep comms short and factual; include link to dashboards and OP actions

---
Templates / canned messages (paste into Slack/email)
- Slack announcement (T-30m):
  "Heads up: deploying runtime v1.14.2 (hotfix) to PROD at 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC. Expected impact: small canary traffic, no downtime. Will post updates in this channel. Paging for SRE if any spike in errors. — Samira"

- Canary OK update:
  "Canary OK: runtime v1.14.2 showing normal latency and error rates in us-east-1. Proceeding with ramp to 100%."

- Rollback notice:
  "Rolling back runtime to v1.14.1 due to elevated errors in canary. Teams: please standby for diagnostics. Will post follow-up with logs and next steps."

END OF SCRATCHPAD
(Will copy relevant bits to Confluence runbook after cutover)
